svg.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Passkey-only sign-in: how the proof of concept works
svg.desc: Sequence diagram in three parts: an admin adds a member and gets a one-time setup link, the member registers a passkey, and the member signs in with it. Four columns: the browser, the app server, Supabase Auth and the Supabase database. A side panel shows the check every protected page makes, what is refused, and the work left for the next phase.
svg.text: Drawn from the code and checked against it (handover/build.py). SB marks a call you would replace in another stack.
Admin or member. Holds its own session only.
Holds the secrets. Decides who gets in.
Checks the passkey, signs the session token.
1 Admin adds a member and gets a setup link
The admin is already signed in with a passkey.
requireAdmin(): a passkey session, and the
Create account with a random password nobody sees
admin_add_member(actor, user, name). The database checks the actor is an admin again
issue_setup_link(actor, user, keyed hash of a 256-bit token, 15 min). The token itself is never stored
Link shown once, with a Copy button
The admin sends the link by hand. The app
The link works once and runs out after 15 minutes.
GET /enrol?t=... shows a Continue page. Nothing is spent.
consume_setup_link(hash): one atomic update, returns the user or nothing
generateLink + verifyOtp: a session with amr = otp
Sets the poc_grant cookie: signed, names the
May this session enrol? Needs the grant cookie
registerPasskey(): the device makes the key and it never leaves the device
Finish: check a passkey exists, end the setup session
No email typed. The device offers the passkey it holds for this site.
signInWithPasskey(): Supabase checks the signature, session carries amr = passkey
THE GATE: getClaims() verifies the token,
current_member(): the database reads the user from the token
Page: You are signed in, with the member's name
The gate: checked on every protected page and action
1. Verify the token's signature and expiry with
2. Its amr must list passkey. A setup-link session (otp)
or a password session fails here.
3. The database must say the person is a member
4. Admin actions: the database must say admin, and each
Hiding a page is not the check. Each page and action
x Missing, forged or expired session cookie
x Signed in but not a member
x A member calling an admin action
x A link used twice, expired, unknown or malformed (all
A link that is only visited, for example by a chat
Secret key, token pepper and cookie secret: server only,
Database: 3 tables with row level security on and no
table access for anyone. 8 functions, 3 callable by a
signed-in user (reads) and 5 by the server only
Assumption: a fixed group that an admin adds, as in a
closed team list. Public self-signup is not covered.
Built with AI assistance. Passkeys are tied to the site
address and do not carry over to another domain.
